sequences.summary: Standard level 100 Dark Knight opener arranged around common raid-buff timing. The training-dummy version omits pre-pull The Blackest Night because the shield will not break.

steps.advice: Unmend starts the GCD rolling while slightly delaying the heavy hits for typical raid-buff application.
steps.timing: Use roughly one second before the pull finishes.
steps.commonMistake: Opening with Hard Slash changes the alignment and requires an extra Hard Slash later.

prompt.text: Begin with Unmend when you are ready. Your first correct action starts the opener, kupo!

steps.advice: Apply Darkside early and begin spending MP before overcapping.
steps.timing: Weave before Hard Slash only when doing so will not clip the GCD.
steps.commonMistake: Forcing this weave from long range can delay Hard Slash. Move it after Hard Slash instead if needed.

steps.advice: Living Shadow has a long spawn delay and updates with buffs in real time, so summon it before raid buffs appear.
steps.timing: Use immediately after the first melee GCD.
steps.commonMistake: Delaying Living Shadow can push its final attacks outside party buffs.

prompt.text: Living Shadow goes out early so its full sequence reaches the raid-buff window.

steps.advice: Delirium enables the Scarlet Delirium combo and generates MP during the burst.
steps.timing: Align it with raid buffs and the upcoming three-GCD Delirium combo.
steps.commonMistake: Entering Delirium above 70 Blood can overcap. Spend Blood beforehand when necessary.

steps.advice: Salted Earth is a 90-second offensive cooldown and should generally be used as soon as it is available.
steps.timing: Place it before the Delirium combo so its damage begins inside the burst.
steps.commonMistake: Holding it unnecessarily loses uses over the encounter.

steps.advice: Scarlet Delirium begins the three-part Delirium weaponskill combo.
steps.timing: Keep the GCD rolling and weave burst abilities between these weaponskills.
steps.commonMistake: Pausing between Delirium GCDs can lose buff coverage.

prompt.text: Keep the Delirium combo moving while weaving the remaining burst abilities.

steps.advice: Shadowbringer has two charges. Both belong in even-minute raid buffs whenever possible.
steps.timing: Weave one charge here and the second later in the same burst.
steps.commonMistake: Sitting on both charges risks losing a use.

steps.advice: Carve and Spit is a one-minute offensive cooldown that also restores MP.
steps.timing: Use promptly in each minute burst so it stays aligned.
steps.commonMistake: Delaying it can cause later uses to miss punctual raid buffs.

steps.advice: Salt and Darkness detonates Salted Earth for additional burst damage.
steps.commonMistake: Forgetting the follow-up wastes a large portion of Salted Earth's value.

prompt.text: Opener complete. Every planned action landed in order, kupo!
